blurb: Guests can climb indoors with options for bouldering and roped climbing, take classes to learn climbing and belaying skills, rent crash pads for outdoor bouldering, and join outdoor climbing trips and courses. The gym offers memberships, daily passes, private instruction, and group climbing packages. Scout programs and private guiding for outdoor climbing are also available.
extraNote: 30-day written notice required to cancel auto-pay membership · Lost or stolen crash pads charged full retail value · Crash pads must be returned by close of business on last rental day · No show for private instruction session charged
